issuer.summary: Lido DAO is an established, publicly governed staking protocol with long-standing identified contributors, a multi-year operating record and no loss of stETH principal. Governance proposals and execution are visible on-chain. The 7.0 score is held below the top band because the issuer is a token-governed DAO rather than a licensed legal entity: it publishes no audited corporate financials, offers no conventional legal counterparty for holders, and accountability is reputational and token-weighted. Contract audits, timelocks and holder veto mechanisms are assessed under Contract & Admin and are not counted again as issuer quality.
facts: Lido has operated stETH since December 2020 without a loss of holder principal.

A September 2026 infrastructure compromise at one operator did not expose staking principal because withdrawal credentials remained with the protocol; the precautionary exit was 98.77% complete on 2026-10-09, 138 validators short of the announced completion date.
Three operator disclosures appeared within two months. Two were voluntary retrospectives, so the higher disclosure count is not treated as evidence that incidents increased.
Two disclosed downtime events caused 7.9667 ETH of combined lost rewards, not slashing or principal loss, and were compensated by the operators.
The resolved Lido treasury held 22,735.5123 stETH at Ethereum block 26,155,953. This is the current observed treasury balance; no separately designated operator-disruption reserve was established.
The score excludes Dual Governance, governance execution delays, audits and the bug bounty because those are contract-control evidence rather than evidence of issuer conduct.
issuer.summary_source: Canonical Ethereum wstETH and underlying stETH assessments, supported by direct protocol and operator-registry reads through 2026-10-10.
